Mina Park: quick heads-up,orchid-v1-int4 bringup on staging shows a weird token split affecting zhuyin+han combos, and an unrelated RTL anchor shift in some arabic+cjk mixed testcases :eyes:
Kai Chen: can you paste a minimal repro/sample?
Mina Park: yes, here's the failing example from our zh-tw->en conv eval set:
Mina Park: ```
input: "臺灣•ㄧ個測試"
float32 output: "Taiwan • a test"
int4 output: "Taiwan • ‌ ㄧ 個 測 試"  # weird ZWNJ/spacing around zhuyin and han
BLEU float32: 28.7
BLEU int4: 23.1
```
Ashok R.: whoa that spacing looks like a tokenization->detokenization mismatch, maybe km-tokenizer split introduced a filler char. which tokenizer version did you use?
Mina Park: onboarding script used tokenizer v2.14 (default in compile), but when I force v2.12 the int4 output matches float32. suspect tokenizer changes + quant kernel ordering.
Priya R.: did you try running the embed dist check? maybe embedding anchors shifted after quantization so reranker chooses broken detok path
Mina Park: ran a quick embed-diff between fp32 and int4 for that input:
Mina Park: ```
# embed L2 between fp32/int4 token embeddings (low numbers ok)
embed_l2: 0.0023 (preface tokens)
anchor_shift: 0.42 (at token index 3)  # big
```
Kai Chen: 0.42 is large. that suggests token mapping changed or KVCACHE alignment mismatch. can you share the `token_map` around the substring?
Mina Park: here's token bytes around the problematic span:
Mina Park: ```
fp32 tokens: [345, 78, 9012, 4021]  # "臺", "灣", "•", "ㄧ個"
int4 tokens: [345, 78, 9012, 0, 129, 4021]  # extra 0 (ZWNJ placeholder) inserted
```
Eval Bot: staging-canary deploy orchid-v1-int4 completed at 2026-03-12T10:12:04Z
Ashok R.: that 0 token smells like our pad/tokenizer sentinel leakage. maybe quantized vocab remap moved an unused slot to index 0 for some subword boundary. did the vocab get reindexed during quant conversion?
Mina Park: conversion logs show `remap_vocab=True` step. I can re-run with `--preserve-ids` tomorrow, but wanted quick eyes to see if this rings bells for anyone who worked on token remap code.
Priya R.: could be a downstream detok rule too — if detok treats ZWNJ codepoint differently it might be inserting U+200C when it sees the 0 sentinel in the token stream. try detok with `--ignore-sentinels` as a temporary hack to confirm.
Kai Chen: please open a bisect task and assign to eng-ml-onboard. repros + minimal script help a lot. command I used locally to reproduce:```
python ./scripts/eval_sample.py --model=orchid-v1-int4 --tokenizer=v2.14 --input="臺灣•ㄧ個測試" --print-tokens
```
Mina Park: done, created task ENGML-6421 and attached logs + `token_map` dumps. linking here: https://internal/issue/ENGML-6421 :thumbsup:
Ashok R.: assigning to me. I'll try a remap-less conversion tonight and run the cross-locale smoke (zh+ar mixed) to also check the RTL anchor problem mentioned.
Mina Park: thanks! also captured a small RTL case where arabic enclitic next to kanji produced reversed punctuation in int4 only. will add to the ticket.
Priya R.: adding eval snapshots to the regression suite so CI can catch this for future quant rollouts. recommend gating canary until we confirm preserve-ids workaround. :thinking_face:
Mina Park: agreed. staging canary paused, leaving logs in task.
Ashok R.: quick note for triage: suspect chain is tokenizer change + remap_vocab + quant kernel reorder -> token id 0 leakage -> detok emits ZWNJ. will try to reproduce with deterministic seed.
Eval Bot: regression-suite job 5123 queued for ENGML-6421
Kai Chen: ping me if you need GPU for repro, I can temp grant a slot.
Mina Park: appreciated, will reach out if needed.
